basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old guy from Tampa, Florida, who recently got into online gaming and fishing. When I'm not strategizing for my next WoW PvP match, you can find me by the water, trying to catch the next big carp. I work as an IT support specialist, which gives me a decent amount of flexibility to game in the evenings and weekends. I'm single and enjoy hanging out with friends at local bars when I'm not glued to my screen.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've always been into computer games and started playing World of Warcraft about a year ago. I learned a lot through online tutorials, watching streams, and trial and error in the game. My interest in fishing is more recent, sparked by a friend's invitation to a weekend trip. I quickly fell in love with the tranquility and challenge of carp fishing.
